name: agentdesktop-acp
comment: Real target, shipped command `agentdesktop acp` from a bundled side-instance copy (scripts/bundle-app.sh, copied to /tmp/adt-acp). Needs the CLI `acp` subcommand (f1). Endpoint is a SIDE INSTANCE under /tmp/adt-acp (docs/acp/tests/e2e-runbook.md), never the product endpoint. Features are switched on as their external dependencies land: task.slow/approval need A6 and PR4; identity.second needs A4. Prompt vars are placeholders until the task catalog (A6) names the neutral sample task.

vars.PROMPT_SLOW: TBD-after-A6: neutral sample task, long variant
vars.PROMPT_SLOW_LONG: TBD-after-A6: neutral sample task, long variant
vars.PROMPT_ACT: TBD-after-PR4: neutral sample task that needs approval
